chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
There is no iʿtikaf except with fasting in the congregational mosque.

key_terms.اعْتِكَافَ: iʿtikaf, spiritual retreat devoted to worship
key_terms.الْجَامِعِ: congregational, referring to the central mosque
key_terms.بِصَوْمٍ: with fasting, indicating sawm as a condition
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ: mosque, the place where the act is observed

ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for a valid iʿtikaf in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal condition for the validity of iʿtikaf: it must be accompanied by sawm (fasting). It also specifies that iʿtikaf is to be observed in a congregational mosque, establishing core jurisprudential rules for the act of worship.
